text: Source: corrected OmicSage reports/kuppe_heart_verified and 06_downstream.h5ad, completed 5 October 2026. Kuppe et al., Nature 608, 766–777 (2022), https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-022-05060-x. Only control sections P1, P17, P7 and P8 are included; no infarction-versus-control comparison. 11719 retained spots, 36601 features including 13 MT genes. MT filtering disabled pending tissue-specific assessment; this does not certify every spot as healthy. Section-specific spatial graph has zero cross-library adjacency entries. 673/3000 candidate SVGs use analytical Moran p-values/BH correction, with pooled centering: section effects can contribute. Four largest expression clusters predominantly track individual sections. NNLS fits raw library-normalized shared nuclear genes against 11 mean snRNA reference signatures, yielding normalized coefficients rather than validated cell counts. Median relative residual norm ||x-Wp||/||x||=0.985; fibroblast, adipocyte and cycling signatures receive zero weights. Lymphoid-associated marker rankings include cardiac genes, a red flag. Therefore do not present 45 composition groups as validated anatomical niches or fitted means as tissue cell fractions. Marker correlations use the same data as fitting and are not independent validation. 1156 GO BP prerank tests use Moran I, with zero FDR<0.05. Lack of significance does not imply lack of biological pathway activity. 7836 ligand-receptor hypotheses at BH q<0.001 depend on uncertain dominant spot-label groups; group adjacency does not establish local contact or communication. Neighbourhood estimates inherit those label limitations. Tangram/imputation not rerun and not part of these updated results.

alt: NPPB spatial expression in P1, P17, P7 and P8, with detection fractions 83.6%, 1.2%, 4.8% and 5.7% and a common expression colour scale.

text: Sources: saved corrected 06_downstream.h5ad and spatial_cluster_report.html; independent descriptive extraction in selected_genes_by_section.csv. MYL2 pooled Moran I=0.759411, NPPB=0.762984, ANKRD1=0.611177. NPPB fraction with log-normalized expression >0: P1 0.836138, P17 0.011719, P7 0.048398, P8 0.056934. NPPB mean log expression: 1.555582, 0.013128, 0.063347, 0.063399 respectively. All sections shown use the same NPPB colour scale, clipped at the pooled 99th percentile for visibility; no H&E image underneath. These maps show RNA expression in mixed-cell spots, not individual annotated cells. Within-section descriptive Moran I for NPPB: P1 0.397305, P17 0.104548, P7 0.402763, P8 0.087396, computed on row-normalized saved section graphs; no new significance testing. Section mean differences contribute to pooled I, so do not call the pooled value replicated within-section evidence. ANKRD1 means P1 2.501681, P17 0.618102, P7 1.099303, P8 1.801183. MYL2 contractile context: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/4633. NPPB/ANKRD1 stress-state context: Kuppe et al., https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-022-05060-x, Extended Data Figs. 6 and 7. The paper studied controls plus infarction tissue and validated stress-associated cardiomyocyte markers; this control-only workflow does not reproduce the disease findings. P1 pattern may reflect biology, sampled region, handling, or other donor/technical effects. Need section-specific validation, metadata and histology; no causal, disease or pathway activation claim.
